title: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7 contain a padding…
description: A padding oracle vulnerability exists in web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library versions before 3.4.10, 4.0.x before 4.0.7, and 4.1.x before 4.1.7. The flaw is due to RSA1_5 decryption lacking implicit rejection, causing timing differences when processing invalid padding, which can be exploited remotely to recover the wrapped content encryption key by measuring these timing differences.
